title: Elliptic-billiard invariant k_{804,b}
exact_target: Show that, for $N=4$, the quantity $AA_j^\dagger=4$ is constant as $P$ varies through the family. The constant may depend on the fixed ellipse and caustic. These are the experimentally recorded assertions of the cited 2020 version.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5100045 (AMR-050-0045). CC BY 4.0.

Dan Reznik, Ronaldo Garcia and Jair Koiller, \emph{Eighty New Invariants in the Elliptic Billiard}, arXiv:2004.12497v11 (29 October 2020), Section 2 and Section 3.9, Table 9, row $k_{804,b}$, pp. 3, 9--12.
